name: Assistio
author: Ad Saeidi

sections.description:
Assistio is a cutting-edge plugin designed for WooCommerce-powered online stores. By integrating advanced AI search methods, it helps customers quickly find the products they need, ultimately increasing conversions and improving the overall shopping experience.

Key features include:
* Multimodal search capabilities for a more interactive user experience.
* Seamless integration with WooCommerce for enhanced functionality.
* Customizable chatbot interface to match your brand’s style.
* Real-time personalized recommendations based on user input.

Automatic API Password Management

To perform secure, automated operations on your WordPress site—such as updating WooCommerce product descriptions or publishing blog posts—Assistio generates a dedicated Application Password during plugin activation.

Short Description

A multimodal AI search platform that enhances online shopping by delivering personalized experiences and boosting conversions.

Arbitrary Section

You may include any additional information or notes here.

External Services

Assistio relies on external services to provide personalized chatbot functionality and training. In order to deliver accurate and efficient AI-powered responses, the plugin collects and sends certain data from your WordPress site to our external services under the following conditions:

Assistio API Service

Purpose:
This service processes site information and plugin configuration data to initialize and manage the chatbot integration.
Data Sent:
Authentication tokens, API keys, and site information (e.g., site URL, site name, and description) are transmitted when setting up and during active use of the plugin.
Links:
Terms of Service:https://assistio.chat/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy:https://assistio.chat/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/assistio directory, or install the plugin directly from the WordPress Plugin Repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Upon activation, you will be redirected to the Assistio Setup page—follow the on-screen instructions to complete the configuration.
sections.faq:
How do I set up Assistio?

After installing and activating the plugin, navigate to the Assistio Setup page from your WordPress dashboard and follow the configuration steps.

Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, Assistio requires WooCommerce to be installed and active.

Where can I get support?

For support, please visit the Assistio Support page within the plugin dashboard or contact us via https://assistio.chat.
